definitions.gloss: professional; occupational; in the course of duties
definitions.explanation: A formal compound noun that prefixes other nouns to mark something as occurring in or arising from the course of one's professional duties. Frequent in legal, news, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {業務上|ぎょうむじょう}の{過失|かしつ}が{認|みと}められた。
{業務上|ぎょうむじょう}{知|し}り{得|え}た{情報|じょうほう}は{他言|たごん}してはいけない。
examples.english: You must not disclose information learned in the course of your duties.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{業務上|ぎょうむじょう}{横領|おうりょう}の{疑|うたが}いで{逮捕|たいほ}された。
examples.english: He was arrested on suspicion of professional embezzlement.

notes:
Compound of {業務|ぎょうむ} (business duties) + {上|じょう} (in the course of, regarding). Used to qualify an act or fact as work-related, often in legal terminology for offenses or duties tied to one's occupation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {業務上|ぎょうむじょう}{過失|かしつ}: professional negligence
- {業務上|ぎょうむじょう}{横領|おうりょう}: occupational embezzlement
- {業務上|ぎょうむじょう}の{秘密|ひみつ}: professional/work secrets
- {業務上|ぎょうむじょう}の{必要|ひつよう}: business necessity
- {業務上|ぎょうむじょう}{災害|さいがい}: occupational accident

USAGE:
Attaches directly before another noun, or with の when modifying another noun more loosely. Belongs to formal written register; in casual speech, {仕事|しごと}で or {仕事上|しごとじょう} is preferred.
